messages:
maya: Quick sync 1: planning a short webinar + launch posts tied to the free-credits pilot. Need: gating rules, 2 social headlines, which 3 starter prompts, and the measurement events. 15m?
jon: +1. Propose Thurs 10am PT. My checklist: CTA mechanics, promo cadence, post-event nurture.
sam: Two headline options: A) Benchmark: "How teams cut inference cost 3x 1 live demo + credits" B) Starter-first: "Starter prompts + free credits to ship your first LLM feature". LinkedIn= A, X/dev channels= B.
li: Routing: attendees -> cookie `webinar_pilot=1`. Issue partial credits on signup, remainder after attendance + first API call. If usage>5 in 7d -> tag sales:hot.
ana: I'll add analytics event `webinar_credit_issued` and `starter_prompt_ran`. Also surface cohort in dashboard. Set an alert if campaign spend > $2k/day.
maya: Sam 1 drop both captions + 1 image each into Notion under /marketing/webinars. Also add alt text.
sam: Done. Starter prompts I added: "summarize-ticket", "rewrite-for-exec", "generate-tests" with one-line examples.
jon: Promo cadence: 10d, 4d, 1d, day-of, post x2. Audience: ML engs, infra, product.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Pilot Webinar: Inference Starter" Thurs 10:00 PT. Invitees: maya, jon, sam, li, ana.
maya: Design review 9am tomorrow. Final items: Sam copy, Ana analytics wiring, Li routing doc, Jon final agenda. Back after sign-off. :rocket:
